blocks.text: Group 17 ke elements halogens kehlate hain aur yeh non-metals hain. “Halogen” ka matlab hai “salt-former” (namak banane wala), kyun ke yeh alkali metals aur alkaline earth metals se asani se react kar ke stable (mazboot) halide salts banate hain. Misal: fluorine, chlorine, bromine. Halogens bohat reactive non-metals hain aur in ki electron affinity zyada hai. Yeh apna bahar wala shell poora karne ke liye asani se ek electron le lete hain.
